title: CubeOS Dashboard — Vue 3 SPA frontend

parent_project.note: Track C of CubeOS — operator UI (Vue 3 + Vite + Pinia + Tailwind). Talks to cubeos-api over HTTP+JWT.

_bounded_contexts_note: 1:1 with real top-level dirs under src/ + dashboard's compose unit (router/, stores/, composables/, etc.).
security_posture: LAN-only (served by nginx inside the operator's CubeOS box); JWT-authenticated to cubeos-api; XSS-defended via Vue's default escaping; CSP locked down in nginx.conf.template; no third-party CDN scripts
_surfaces_note: Dashboard is a static SPA — no server-side HTTP API of its own (consumes cubeos-api's). No event bus. Persistent state lives in cubeos-api/HAL, not in browser.
